pad.title: The cost of legacy operations
pad.body:
Most companies don't fail because of bad strategy — they fail because legacy operations throttle execution. Decision loops take weeks. Talent sits in silos. Technology is bolted on rather than built in. The result is an organisation that knows where it needs to go but can't move fast enough to get there.

Karon Galáxia was built to solve this. We combine operational design expertise with the Mainland WebOS and a workforce methodology that replaces rigid hierarchies with dynamic, outcome-driven teams. The result is a company that operates at the speed of the market it's trying to serve.
pad.highlight: Legacy operations are a strategic liability. Transformation is the unlock.
